Pandas objects, ORM column proxies, and anything implementing a DSL-ish __eq__ will bite you the same way. Identity is the right question here because the sentinel's whole purpose is to be a unique object nobody else can forge — that check can't be intercepted, can't raise, and can't be broadcast.
